name: Camp Dick Campground
evidence: Satellite 40.1298,-105.5192: meadow loops, Middle St Vrain along north edge behind willow/conifer band. OSM: catalogued sites 38-52 m (010, 012, 009, 008, 007), rest 100+ m. rec.gov photos 007-012, 021-036 show no water; no per-site tags or map. Uncatalogued north spur ~12-16 m from creek not confirmed as an RV pad.

name: Chambers Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov site photos 032, 038, 039, 041, 042, 044 show lake filtered through trees, downslope from forested bench (042 has steps). Satellite: peninsula, drawn-down reservoir; 039/040/043/044 ~30-45 m through trees from high-water sand edge, no pads at water. 036 is 21 ft, doesn't count.

name: Chapman Campground
evidence: rec.gov site photos 011, 017, 018, 019 show Fryingpan River right behind the table (018 ~15-20 m). Satellite: 012/013 ~28 m, 018-020 ~24-27 m, bankside trees only. These are reservable standard sites, Max Vehicle Length 25-30 ft. Lake side is view only: 023-025 set back, 026/027 tent, shore treeline.

name: Difficult Campground
evidence: Satellite 39.1405,-106.7735 at the new pin: pads in aspen/conifer, Roaring Fork behind dense conifer band; nearest pad with rig ~40 m+. OSM: individual sites 62 m+ (036), only group 001 at 35 m. rec.gov preview photos of all 46 individual sites (001-047, no 037) show aspen, shrubs, conifers, no water, incl. sites by unnamed OSM side channel. River's-edge prose can't earn it.

name: Elliott Creek Campground
evidence: rec.gov photos 002-004, 015-019 show reservoir across low sage/open ground. Satellite: 001-004 ~43 m sage band to high-water; 016-018 have spur road between them and bank. USGS EPQS: pads 2430-2436 m vs full pool ~2423 m, a 7-13 m bench; 015 at bank edge but ~7 m above pool, steep. Reservoir side of dam.

name: Father Dyer Campground
evidence: Satellite around 39.2746,-106.3511: dense lodgepole; Turquoise Lake shore only in SW corner, nearest site ~280 m through continuous forest with other roads and loops between. rec.gov photos of 12 sites in 002-026 show forest only, no filtered lake view.

name: Pawnee Campground
evidence: Satellite 40.0790,-105.5745: MOOSE/ELK loops ~300 m east of Brainard Lake's east shore, with developed day-use lots, roads and forest between; South St Vrain ~110 m north of nearest RV site (037). Walk-in W1-8 are tent-only. rec.gov has no site photos to check for a filtered view.

name: Marble RV Park and Campground
evidence: Official map (marblecampground.com/campground-map): 16 pads around church foundation/bath house, no river. Operator: "up from the Crystal River". Satellite 39.0691,-107.1908: foundation ~30 m from pin; south edge ~39.0695, river ~60 m south through dense conifers. Prior evidence's pad rows are the Millsite Park gravel lot across the road.
